lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A highly ordered grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in discrete vertical columns of 4 to 6 spots each, extending from the posterior gill region to the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the lateral circular blobs, creating a series of anchor nodes that define a rigid rectangular coordinate system across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with light-exposed upper edges and shadowed lower edges, tracking longitudinally towards the tail.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse to moderate distribution of small high-luminance spots localized within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, with a higher concentration observed along the leading edge compared to the trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct morphological transition in patterning is visible, moving from a high-density stochastic distribution of small spots on the cranial region to a low-density, structured grid-like pattern on the torso.
